response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software engineering, including roles at re:cinq (AI-agent infrastructure), Optilyz (pricing automation), and GISCollective (open-source geo-data platform). His technical depth spans multiple languages and domains, but his resume lacks explicit AI expertise, entrepreneurial experience, or recognized products/platforms built with AI, which are preferred for this role. His recent work shows strong engineering leadership but may not fully align with the AI strategy focus required.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, AI-agent infrastructure)
Proven leadership in building and maintaining complex systems (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq AI-agent tools)
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement (talks, workshops, GitHub contributions)
concerns: Limited explicit AI specialization or entrepreneurial experience within larger organizations
No PhD or Master's degree in an AI-related field, which is preferred
Recent role at re:cinq (April 2025–Present) may not reflect sufficient depth in AI strategy or cloud/AI product development for a director-level role

key_factors.factor: Entrepreneurial or startup experience within larger organizations
